name: Suzuoka Honoka
source:
A girl who lives in the neighborhood of the confectionery store where the protagonist  works.

She meets the protagonist when she is trying to decide which cake to buy for her friend who is hospitalized for illness. She was wondering why he was always skipping work at the store.

[From [url=http://www.studio-74.net/works/works-patisserie.html]official site[/url]]
